title: Community minerals (literature peaks)
citation: Wavenum community pack: published peak positions; source DOI per entry.

entries.name: Wangdaodeite
entries.info: doi:10.1111/maps.13426 | Suizhou L6 chondrite (Xie et al. 2020, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.). Band centres of the reported ranges 174-179, 273-277, 560-567, 738-743 cm-1; the 738-743 band is diagnostic. Relative intensities approximate.

entries.name: Akimotoite
entries.info: https://nipr.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/13407/files/M_BercziSzaniszlo_2_P.pdf | NWA 5011 L6 chondrite shock vein. 799 cm-1 is the main band. Relative intensities approximate.

entries.name: Hemleyite
entries.info: doi:10.1038/srep42674 | Suizhou L6 chondrite (Bindi et al. 2017, Sci. Rep.). Fe analogue of akimotoite; strongest band near 795 cm-1. Relative intensities approximate.

entries.name: Majorite
entries.info: https://journals.uair.arizona.edu/index.php/maps/article/viewFile/15585/15573 | Majoritic garnet in Sixiangkou L6 chondrite shock veins. 930 cm-1 is the most consistently reported band. Relative intensities approximate.

entries.name: Poirierite (calculated)
entries.info: doi:10.1038/s43247-020-00090-7 | First-principles calculated Raman bands below 900 cm-1 (Tomioka et al. 2021, Commun. Earth Environ.); not a measured spectrum.

entries.name: Elaliite
entries.info: doi:10.2138/am-2023-9225 | El Ali IAB iron meteorite, IMA 2022-087 (Herd et al. 2024, Am. Mineral.). Sharp PO4 band at 938, broad hump at 487 cm-1.

entries.name: Elkinstantonite
entries.info: doi:10.2138/am-2023-9225 | El Ali IAB iron meteorite, IMA 2022-088 (Herd et al. 2024). Peaks between 930 and 1020 cm-1 including the 940/975 doublet; only the doublet is listed.

entries.name: Olsenite
entries.info: doi:10.2138/am-2023-9225 | El Ali IAB iron meteorite, IMA 2022-100 (Herd et al. 2024). Single PO4 stretching mode at 968, weak band at 648 cm-1.

entries.name: Ellinaite
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-33-727-2021 | Post-spinel oxide, Hatrurim Basin and Juina kimberlite inclusions (Sharygin et al. 2021, Eur. J. Mineral.). Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Nannoniite
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-36-1011-2024 | Cetine di Cotorniano mine, Tuscany (2024). Bands 100-1200 cm-1; O-H stretching region not included. Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Moabite
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-37-353-2025 | Natural oxyphosphate (2025). P-O stretching (843, 871, 918) weighted up. Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Silesiaite
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-33-165-2021 | El Valle-Boinas skarn, Spain (2021). Sharp bands 544, 592, 735; broad weak 843, 989, 1034 cm-1. Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Kenoargentotetrahedrite-(Zn)
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-36-397-2024 | Yindongpo Au deposit, China (2024). Main Sb-S band 353 with shoulder 346 cm-1. Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Batoniite
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-35-703-2023 | Cetine di Cotorniano mine (2023). Very strong SO4 band at 995 cm-1; broad O-H band 2800-3750 cm-1. Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Belmonteite
entries.info: doi:10.5194/ejm-38-531-2026 | Gambatesa mine, Italy (2026). Strong AsO4 band 839 with shoulders 815 and 891 cm-1; other bands not listed in the text. Relative intensities approximate (the paper lists positions only).

entries.name: Tissintite
entries.info: doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2015.03.057 | Type material, Tissint martian meteorite (Ma et al. 2015, EPSL). Jadeite-like spectrum. Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Ahrensite
entries.info: doi:10.1016/j.gca.2016.04.042 | Type material, Tissint (Ma et al. 2016, GCA): 212 broad, 294 sharper, 843 the most intense, 916 broad; noisy spectrum. Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Donwilhelmsite
entries.info: doi:10.2138/am-2020-7393 | Lunar meteorite Oued Awlitis 001 (Fritz et al. 2020, Am. Mineral.). Spectrum includes contributions of surrounding glass. Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Zagamiite
entries.info: doi:10.1111/maps.13735 | Shergottite NWA 7397 (Yoshida et al. 2021, MAPS), bands assigned to the CAS phase after Beck et al. (2004). Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Reidite
entries.info: doi:10.1029/2020GL089583 | Lunar meteorite Sayh al Uhaymir 169 (Xing et al. 2020, GRL). Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Xieite
entries.info: doi:10.1007/s11434-008-0407-1 | Suizhou L6 chondrite (Chen et al. 2008, Chin. Sci. Bull.): strong band at 605 with a shoulder at 665 cm-1.

entries.name: Liebermannite (synthetic)
entries.info: doi:10.1111/maps.13000 | Synthetic end-member (Ma et al. 2018, MAPS). Natural type liebermannite in Zagami gave featureless Raman spectra. Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Lingunite
entries.info: doi:10.2138/am.2013.4300 | Taiban L chondrite melt vein (Acosta-Maeda et al. 2013, Am. Mineral.); 763 cm-1 is the SiO6 symmetric stretch of the hollandite structure. Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).

entries.name: Kopernikite
entries.info: doi:10.1180/mgm.2026.10230 | Morasko IAB-MG iron meteorite (Galuskin et al. 2026, Mineral. Mag.). Centres of the reported ranges 127-133, 180-187, 273-283, 350-357, 500-503, 603-611, 679-681, 722-732, 786-811 cm-1. Relative intensities approximate (positions from the text).
